Name: Cardholder_Spend
Description: Recorded account-month card spend; not airline revenue.

Name: Baggage_Compensation
Description: Recorded baggage compensation in source monetary units.

Name: Baggage_Average_Resolution_Days
Description: Mean non-null recorded days to resolve a baggage claim.

Name: Baggage_Claim_Count
Description: Claim records, not number of bags or unique passengers.

Name: Loyalty_Miles_Earned
Description: Monthly loyalty miles earned; additive flow, unlike miles_balance_end.

Name: Loyalty_Miles_Redeemed
Description: Monthly loyalty miles redeemed; additive flow.

Name: Ancillary_Net_Revenue
Description: Net ancillary transaction amount; purchase-period basis unless explicitly filtered by travel date.

Name: Ancillary_Contribution
Description: Net amount less recorded ancillary cost; not full airline operating profit.

Name: Ancillary_Transaction_Count
Description: Ancillary sale records, not passengers or total item quantity.

Name: Average_Airport_Weather_Severity
Description: Mean recorded severity at airport-day grain; not flight-weighted and not a causal estimate.

Name: Arrival_On_Time_%
Description: Eligible arrivals exclude cancelled and diverted flights; confirm flag encoding in validation.
SQL: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.diverted_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.arrival_on_time_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.diverted_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.diverted_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.arrival_on_time_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.diverted_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expanded SQL: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.diverted_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.arrival_on_time_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 0 AND wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.diverted_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)

Name: Cancellation_Rate_%
Description: Cancelled scheduled flight legs divided by all scheduled flight legs.
SQL: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)
Expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)
Expanded SQL: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT.cancelled_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)

Name: Cabin_Passenger_Count_Load_Factor_%
Description: Boarded passengers / available cabin seats; ratio of sums at flight-cabin grain.

Name: Cabin_Passenger_Revenue
Description: Passenger revenue at flight-cabin grain in source units.

Name: Service_Case_Cash_Compensation
Description: Cash compensation only; do not add compensation_miles without an agreed valuation.

Name: First_Contact_Resolution_%
Description: Share of valid binary first-contact-resolution flags equal to 1.
SQL: 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag IN (0,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expression: 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag IN (0,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expanded SQL: 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_SERVICE_CASE.first_contact_resolved_flag IN (0,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)

Name: Average_Service_Resolution_Days
Description: Mean recorded non-null resolution days; open cases may have no recorded resolution.

Name: Average_Service_CSAT
Description: Mean non-null service-case satisfaction score; preserve recorded score scale.

Name: Service_Case_Count
Description: Count of service cases, not unique passengers.

Name: Route_Total_Revenue
Description: Sum at route-month grain; preserve source money units.

Name: Route_Passenger_Revenue
Description: Sum at route-month grain; preserve source money units.

Name: Route_Ancillary_Revenue
Description: Sum at route-month grain; preserve source money units.

Name: Route_Operating_Cost
Description: Sum at route-month grain; preserve source money units.

Name: Route_Operating_Income
Description: Sum at route-month grain; preserve source money units.

Name: Route_Budget_Revenue
Description: Sum at route-month grain; preserve source money units.

Name: Route_Budget_Operating_Income
Description: Sum at route-month grain; preserve source money units.

Name: Passenger_Count_Load_Factor_%
Description: Boarded passengers / available seats; ratio of sums; 0–100.

Name: Distance_Weighted_Load_Factor_%
Description: RPM / ASM; 0–100; distinct from passenger-count load factor.

Name: Operating_Margin_%
Description: Operating income / total revenue; 0–100 percentage scale.

Name: RASM
Description: Source money units per available seat mile; not cents unless explicitly converted.

Name: PRASM
Description: Passenger revenue per ASM in source money units.

Name: CASM
Description: Full operating cost per ASM in source money units.

Name: Passenger_Yield
Description: Passenger revenue per RPM in source money units.

Name: Revenue_Versus_Budget
Description: Actual less budget revenue; positive is above budget.

Name: Income_Versus_Budget
Description: Actual less budget operating income.

Name: Card_Application_Approval_%
Description: Approved application records divided by all application records; not approval among decided-only applications.

Name: Crew_Overtime_Hours
Description: Assignment overtime minutes converted to hours; not unique flight duration.

Name: Crew_Assignment_Pay
Description: Recorded pay at crew-assignment grain; do not add to route crew cost without reconciliation.

Name: Survey_NPS
Description: NPS from valid 0–10 responses; range -100 to 100.
SQL: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 1 WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 1 WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
Expanded SQL: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 1 WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY.nps_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)

Name: Survey_Response_Count
Description: Survey records; include valid NPS denominator separately when computing NPS.

Name: Maintenance_Event_Cost
Description: Total recorded cost at maintenance-event grain.

Name: Maintenance_Downtime_Hours
Description: Recorded event downtime hours. Overlapping events can overlap elapsed aircraft downtime; do not call this distinct aircraft out-of-service duration.

Name: Co-brand_Net_Remuneration
Description: Partner remuneration less recorded program cost at product-month grain.
